run_celeb_a_hq_test: run the meta learning experiment test on the celeb_a_hq dataset with a single training step
test_experiment_step: test a single experiment step using the functa Experiment class with JAX pmap broadcasting
configure_meta_learning: configure the functa meta learning experiment with custom dataset, batch size, and model parameters
create_experiment_instance: create a functa Experiment instance with a PRNG key and experiment configuration for training
get_experiment_config: get the default functa experiment configuration and modify dataset, training, and model settings
